    (filtered_metric_df['timestamp'] >= start_ext_time) &
    (filtered_metric_df['timestamp'] <= end_ext_time)
].copy()

# Calculate global P5 thresholds for each component-KPI time series using entire data (not filtered by time)
p5_thresholds = (
    filtered_metric_df.groupby(['cmdb_id', 'name'])['value']
    .quantile(0.05)
    .reset_index()
    .rename(columns={'value': 'P5_Threshold'})

# Merge thresholds with extended_time_df to compare values against thresholds

    extended_time_df,
    thresholds,

    how='left'
